state_candidates.meaning: Available evidence cannot support even a stable potential direction.
Conditions may be forming Intent but evidence is insufficient.
Multiple governed references increasingly support a direction candidate.
A qualified direction currently participates in cognitive processing.
A candidate remains preserved but another constraint or candidate reduces its active influence.
A preserved candidate is not currently activated.
New context or reference support reactivates a preserved candidate.
Evidence suggests the intended state relation may have been resolved; downstream validation remains separate.
A governed candidate is no longer pursued while its trace remains available.

transition_semantics: UNKNOWN may remain UNKNOWN without forced classification
SUPPRESSED and DORMANT candidates remain preserved
REACTIVATED requires new support or context match
RESOLVED_CANDIDATE does not assert outcome truth
